# ISwapPool
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/benji/ISwapPool.sol)

**Title:**
ISwapPool

Minimal interface for the Franklin Templeton `SwapPool` used by `BenjiArk`.

The SwapPool swaps a registered/authorized token pair at a fixed 1:1 rate with decimal
normalization (e.g. a 6-decimal stable leg <-> 18-decimal iBENJI): the output is exactly
`convertDecimals(amount, fromDecimals, toDecimals)`. The pool charges no fee and enforces
exact delivery in both directions (it reverts if the amounts received or sent deviate),
which is why `BenjiArk` values iBENJI at 1:1 par and checks board/disembark outputs
strictly. Neither `swap` overload returns the received amount, so callers must measure the
`toToken` balance delta to learn how much was delivered. `swap` pulls `fromToken` from
`msg.sender` via `transferFrom`, so the caller must approve the pool first. Only the subset
of functions consumed by the Ark is declared here.


## Functions
### swap

Swap `amount` of `fromToken` for the 1:1 decimal-normalized amount of `toToken`,
delivering the output to `msg.sender`.


```solidity
function swap(address fromToken, address toToken, uint256 amount) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`fromToken`|`address`|The token being sold (pulled from `msg.sender`)|
|`toToken`|`address`|The token being bought (sent to `msg.sender`)|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of `fromToken` to swap, in `fromToken` decimals|


### swap

Swap and deliver the output to an explicit `destination`.


```solidity
function swap(address fromToken, address toToken, uint256 amount, address destination) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`fromToken`|`address`|The token being sold (pulled from `msg.sender`)|
|`toToken`|`address`|The token being bought|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of `fromToken` to swap, in `fromToken` decimals|
|`destination`|`address`|The recipient of `toToken` (defaults to `msg.sender` if zero)|


### getTokenBalance

Returns the pool's available balance of `token`.


```solidity
function getTokenBalance(address token) external view returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`address`|The token to query|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The pool-held balance, in `token` decimals|


### isTraderAllowed

Whether `trader` may swap the `tokenA`/`tokenB` pair (pair authorized and, if the pair
enforces trader authorization, the trader is on the allow-list).


```solidity
function isTraderAllowed(address trader, address tokenA, address tokenB) external view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`trader`|`address`|The trader to check|
|`tokenA`|`address`|One token of the pair|
|`tokenB`|`address`|The other token of the pair|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|True if the trader is allowed to swap the pair|


### unsupportedTokens

Whether `token` is flagged unsupported (all swaps involving it revert). An
owner-mutable kill-switch independent of pair authorization.


```solidity
function unsupportedTokens(address token) external view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`token`|`address`|The token to check|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|True if the token is flagged unsupported|


### isTokenPairAuthorized

Whether the `tokenA`/`tokenB` pair is authorized for swapping.


```solidity
function isTokenPairAuthorized(address tokenA, address tokenB) external view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`tokenA`|`address`|One token of the pair|
|`tokenB`|`address`|The other token of the pair|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|True if the pair is authorized|


### paused

Whether the pool is currently paused (all swaps revert while paused).


```solidity
function paused() external view returns (bool);
```
